facts.fact: Tika 把蜂蜜抹在 Mearna 脚踝到膝盖那些纵横交错的划伤与咬伤上，再用煮过的牛蒡叶与黑莓藤条包扎。
facts.anchor: Tika was smoothing honey onto the many cuts

facts.fact: Diarban 与 Long Liam 走到营地向 Mearna 传话，说 Flann 把所有人召到 High Oak。
facts.anchor: Flann’s called us all to the High Oak

facts.fact: Mearna 抱怨营地才扎下两周，自己刚被地精咬得遍体鳞伤，Tika 整上午都在给她清洗包扎。
facts.anchor: We only set up camp here a fortnight ago

facts.fact: Flann 宣布新营地不在 Deep Den，而在北方 Drochbor 桥附近的 Mullachi 丘陵。
facts.anchor: Near the Drochbor Bridge, in the Mullachi Hills.

facts.fact: Flann 问 Diarban 匪帮里有多少人会摆弄乐器，并且只给他一天时间。
Flann 要 Mearna 与女人们用铁胆染过的宽幅布缝至少两打罩袍，随后改口把这活交给 Tika。
facts.anchor: sew up at least two dozen tabards

facts.fact: Diarban 报告只找到四个懂点音乐的人：Sherdan、Mud Boy、Pooley One-Eye 与 Brother Edgar。
facts.anchor: I have located four who have at least some knowledge

facts.fact: Flann 改让 Mearna 明天随他回 Crannhyr，并要她缝补 Pooley 风笛裂开的气囊。
facts.anchor: you will come with me tomorrow instead

facts.fact: Diarban 当面质问自由团的承诺，Flann 答他仍然自由，可 Scaeth 会把森林烧光。
facts.anchor: This has always been a free company, Flann!
